Ubharte kalakar | chhote muri se bare manchon tak mohan sahis ka nrity saphar | Emerging Dance Talent of Jharkhand | DD Jharkhand
Jharkhand ki mati pratibha, kala aur sanskriti ki anmol dharohar hai. yahan ke ganvon aur kasbon men anek aise kalakar hain, jo apni mehnat, lagan aur junun se apni alag pahchan banane ka sapna dekhte hain. aisi hi prernadayak kahani hai ranchi jile ke silli prakhand antargat chhote muri ke ubharte nrity kalakar mohan sahis ki.
